message:
1 bare wait(s) standing where a condition belongs:
      sheen.spec.ts:13 — await page.waitForTimeout(150) and line 14 takes the baseline `$held` straight after it: const $held = await styleOf(shade, ' ')
    The
why: The paused sheen's baseline taken straight after a measured 150 ms, under the name `$held`. Point 4 refuses a baseline only when a later assertion measures against it, and finds that assertion by the name — unescaped, the `$` is the end of the input, the name is never found again, and the bare wait goes by unreported.
